svg.title: Support tickets by topic
svg.desc: Time chart with 26 points from 2026-01-05 to 2026-12-21 and 4 series (Billing, Login, Mobile app, Exports). Highest: 59 (Billing in 2026-03-16, Billing in 2026-03-30, Billing in 2026-04-13). Lowest: 9 (Exports in 2026-12-21). Streamgraph, from the bottom up: Billing, Login, Mobile app, Exports; the areas are centered on a moving baseline, so thickness shows the value and position does not; the scale bar marks one step.
